items.title: Diesel Prices Are Surging and ExxonMobil Stock Could Benefit
items.summary: Oil is moving freely again through the Strait of Hormuz, but refined fuel is still locked up, and that mismatch is reshaping who feels the pain and who holds the pricing power. Investors watching diesel hit new records in the U.S. are really watching a story about margins, policy risk and supply chains. items.title: America’s Strategic Oil Reserves Are at 44-Year Lows — And Trump Just Gave Away Another 40 Million Barrels
items.summary: America's emergency oil stockpile is draining toward levels not seen since Reagan was president, and the administration just authorized another massive release at the worst possible moment for global supply. What gets left behind matters far more than what goes out the door.

items.title: Why Is SLB (SLB) Expanding Its LNG Footprint With A Mozambique Subsea Win?
items.summary: SLB (NYSE:SLB) said its OneSubsea joint venture won a contract from ExxonMobil for the Rovuma LNG project in Mozambique. The award covers subsea production systems for the first phase of Rovuma LNG, a deepwater gas development offshore Mozambique. OneSubsea plans to establish a services base in Mozambique under the deal, supporting long term field operations and local capacity.
